name: Al-Ghazali (Algazel)
shortBio: Influential Persian Islamic theologian and jurist who critiqued Avicennian Aristotelianism and formulated occasionalism, anticipating Humean causal skepticism.
centralQuestion: Does human philosophical reason possess the capacity to prove necessary causal laws and transcendent metaphysical truths?

keyWorks.title: The Incoherence of the Philosophers (Tahafut al-Falasifa)
keyWorks.description: Landmark philosophical critique of Islamic Peripatetic philosophy and necessary causal connection.

keyWorks.title: Deliverance from Error (Al-Munqidh min al-Dalal)
keyWorks.description: Autobiographical spiritual treatise recounting his epistemological crisis and Sufi resolution.
